body_markdown:
***Pursing an*** ***NDA Submission***


***for DMD-Associated Cardiomyopathy***


***Transitioning Our Commercial Brands and Team to Apotex Health*** ******


The third quarter of 2026 marked the first period of Cumberland’s operations following the close of our Strategic Transaction and our pivot to a focus on the development of new medicines for the future.


As a result, we recently announced the decision to submit a New Drug Application (NDA) to the FDA for approval of our ifetroban product candidate as a potential treatment for patients with the cardiomyopathy associated with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD). As discussed in that announcement, we decided to proceed with the submission in order to help address the important unmet medical need in patients suffering from the symptoms associated with this life-threatening disease.


Meanwhile, we continue to support the transition of our commercial portfolio and team to Apotex Health, based on our commitments associated with the Strategic Transaction. The completion of that agreement strengthened our balance sheet, simplified our business model, and allowed us to concentrate our resources on our clinical pipeline, which we believe is a source of potential long-term value for our shareholders.


Following the Transaction, we completed a strategic planning process to take a fresh look at and define who we are and where we are headed. Our resulting new mission statement reflects our emphasis on innovation:


**Advancing new therapies that address significant unmet medical needs** .


As we proceed through the final quarter of 2026, I want to recognize our Board for their leadership, our employees for their dedicated efforts and our shareholders for their continued support as we pursue our new mission.


As we look ahead, Cumberland is focused on translating its clinical progress into meaningful development and regulatory milestones. Our strengthened financial position, experienced team and established capabilities in drug and corporate development provide a strong positioning for this next phase. We believe these strengths position us to advance our pipeline, pursue strategic partnerships, and create new opportunities for Cumberland and the patients we aim to serve.


*Please see our corporate website at*[www.cumberlandpharma.com](https://www.cumberlandpharma.com/) ** *for more information and our SEC filings that contain the risk factors and other information associated with our business.* **
